description: GDSC2 (release 8.5, GDSC2_fitted_dose_response_27Oct23) per drug x genotype group summaries. LN_IC50 = natural log of IC50 in micromolar (extrapolated beyond the screened range by the GDSC NLME fit, so values above ln(max_conc) are extrapolations). AUC = area under the fitted viability curve over the screened range, normalised to 1 (1 = no effect).
mutation_source: Cell Model Passports mutations_all_latest (coding variants); PTEN homozygous deletion from cnv_summary_latest (cn_category == Deletion). Lines without CMP mutation data are excluded from genotype groups but included in g_all_solid.

flag_definitions.RAS_RAF_wt: no KRAS/NRAS/HRAS hotspot and no BRAF variant flagged cancer_driver

group_definitions.d_KRAS_mut_lung_or_pancreas: tissue Lung (any lung cancer type) or Pancreatic Carcinoma, KRAS hotspot
group_definitions.e_RAS_RAF_wt_colorectal: Colorectal with mutation data, no KRAS/NRAS/HRAS hotspot and no BRAF driver mutation
group_definitions.f_PIK3CA_mut_or_PTEN_null_colorectal_or_: Colorectal or Breast; PIK3CA driver missense/inframe or PTEN truncating/homozygous deletion
group_definitions.f3_breast_PIK3CA_PTEN_wt: comparator: Breast with mutation data, PIK3CA wt and PTEN not null
group_definitions.g_all_solid: all solid-tumour lines (CMP tissue not Haematopoietic and Lymphoid)
group_definitions.i_EGFR_mut_NSCLC: extra: NSCLC with EGFR driver mutation (CMP cancer_driver flag)
group_definitions.j_RAS_RAF_wt_solid: extra: all solid lines with no RAS hotspot / BRAF driver
